card.name: Linking words before meal timing
card.fires_on: Small linking words (each, the, before, to, of) in dosing directions, right before a meal, food or start-of-event timing phrase.

modes.label: Before/with meals
modes.description: The word 'before' or 'with' just ahead of a meal or food term in timing instructions.
modes.example: one hour<< before>> lunch and one hour before dinner.

modes.label: Each/the before meal
modes.description: 'each' or 'the' after 'with' or 'at', leading into 'main meal' or 'start'.
modes.example: three times a day with<< each>> main meal containing fat

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward words that continue a meal or event timing phrase, though the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up on little words like 'before' or 'with each' that lead into a meal time in dosing instructions.
